stem: A collaborative robot detects excess contact force, predicts a human’s next action and explains why it stopped. Which combination matches the HRI slide?

options.text: Safe physical interaction; intent prediction; explainability
Gesture recognition; intent prediction; speech recognition
Safe physical interaction; explainability; intent prediction
Intent prediction; safe physical interaction; explainability

Intent Prediction Explainability • Force/torque sensing. • Predict human next action. • Why did the robot do X? • Impedance control. • Social force models. • Attention maps, LIME, SHAP. • Collision detection & stop. • Attention estimation. • Voice narration of decisions. • Cobot safety standards. • Proactive robot assistance. • Critical for trust building. 37

solution.justification: The HRI design combines safe contact, anticipatory assistance and understandable decisions. LIME, SHAP, attention maps and narration are named explanatory examples, not substitutes for safe control.

optionExplanations.W01-L02-Q-084-o1: Correct: force/stop, next-action prediction and why-did-it-act are the corresponding roles.
optionExplanations.W01-L02-Q-084-o2: This swaps contact-force safety monitoring and prediction of a human’s next action.
optionExplanations.W01-L02-Q-084-o3: The second operation predicts an action; the third explains a past robot decision.
optionExplanations.W01-L02-Q-084-o4: Force monitoring is not hand/body gesture recognition, and explaining a decision is not merely transcribing speech.

solution.simpleExplanation: Predicting or explaining an action does not replace safety sensing.
